data.long_meaning: The name Baiju is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vat' which means 'banyan tree'. In Hindu mythology, the banyan tree is considered sacred and symbolizes strength, stability, and longevity. The name Baiju is thus believed to bestow upon the bearer the qualities of strength, resilience, and nurturing abilities.
